purpose: Resolve curriculum and textbook locators without duplicating progression content.

CN.method: Match concept/domain to the China 2022 learning stage and hierarchy. Render the verified printed domain range plus stage/section where useful. Do not invent an exact single page for an individual bullet when it has not been directly rendered.

UK.method: Resolve the concept from the relevant verified domain file, select the requested Year entry, and render National Curriculum in England → Year N → named programme-of-study strand. Do not label the whole UK.

US.method: Resolve the concept from the relevant verified domain file, select the requested Grade entry and render the stored standard_codes. If no Grade 1-6 Common Core standard exists, say so instead of forcing a match.

PEP_revised.method: Render grade + semester + exact unit from the authoritative revised-series sequence. Add subsection/lesson/page only when a registered detail record supports it at that evidence level. Resolve actual-use/rollout separately.

rules: A locator identifies where a claim comes from; it does not increase the verification status of the claim.
For England, keep Year labels as England Year N in Chinese output.
For Common Core, keep Grade labels as Common Core Grade N in Chinese output.
For China, national curriculum learning-stage placement and PEP textbook placement are separate locators.
Do not invent a standard code or page number when only a broader locator is verified.
Do not use legacy PEP textbook locators as revised/current evidence.
Teaching guidance and research evidence use their own source-specific locators and must not be presented as statutory curriculum locators.
